subject: Transportation Systems
title: Congestion Pricing
description: A micro-lesson that makes Congestion Pricing usable.

hook.text: London charges drivers up to £15 per day to enter the city center. It works.

buildup.text: Congestion pricing makes driving expensive where roads are most crowded, pushing some trips to transit.

discovery.text: London's scheme cut central traffic by 30% in its first year. Bus speeds jumped immediately.

twist.text: Stockholm voters initially opposed congestion pricing. After a trial, they voted to keep it.

climax.text: New York launched its own congestion zone in 2024. Revenue funds transit improvements.

punchline.text: Price the road, and people find another way.

quiz.question: What happened after London introduced congestion pricing?
